remarks: This tri-level townhouse in a peaceful Riverside setting features high ceilings, hardwood floors and an up-dated eat-in kitchen with soapstone countertops and stainless-steel appliances. The sunny living room/dining room has a fireplace and double sliders to a deck with river views. The primary bedroom on the second floor has a renovated bathroom with a walk-in shower. In addition, there are two family bedrooms, one bedroom with a skylight. a bath and laundry complete the second floor. On the third floor you will find a studio/possible 4th bedroom with built-ins, a closet and skylight. There is an attached garage and a designated carport with an electric car charger.
